CHAR.AETHER_bio: This old man has solved the mysteries of space and time when he was half your age.
CHAR.AETHER_l2: You can now slow down time. Use it wisely!
CHAR.AETHER_l3: Go into slo-mo more frequently and for a longer period.
CHAR.BRAGG_bio: This feARRRless sea wolf has a sixth sense for gold.
CHAR.BRAGG_l2: Say hello to Gem, your faithful parrot friend!
CHAR.BRAGG_l3: Every pirate needs a pistol. Here, take this one!
CHAR.BRAGG_l4: Now if you shoot a living beast, you get the gold back!
CHAR.BRAGG_l5: Killing shots now earn you more money than they cost!
CHAR.CREEP_bio: When the Dungeon scares him, he scares it back!
CHAR.CREEP_l2: Creep up to some bats or slimes and scare them to death!
CHAR.CREEP_l3: Scare twice as often! Now you really are the scariest thing in the Dungeon!
CHAR.CREEP_l4: Bad news: your head is still a watermelon. Good news: you can now jump over small gaps!
CHAR.GYLBARD_bio: A fearless knight obsessed with reinforcing, improving and polishing his armor.
CHAR.GYLBARD_l2: Better armor! Now you can take a hit and stay alive.
CHAR.GYLBARD_l3: You suddenly remember you've had a sword all this time!
CHAR.GYLBARD_l4: Even better armor! You can take two hits now.
CHAR.GYLBARD_l5: Best armor ever! Also, you can hit things more often.
CHAR.ICHI_bio: Dancing non-stop to please the spirits of gold.
CHAR.ICHI_l2: Attract coins from twice as far!
CHAR.ICHI_l3: You don't seek treasure, treasure seeks you!
CHAR.ICHI_l4: The chests are not strong enough to resist your power over gold!
CHAR.KAZHAN_bio: He was a bat in previous life. He'll be a bat in the next one.
CHAR.KAZHAN_l2: The bats taught you how to fly. I repeat: you can now FLY.
CHAR.KAZHAN_l3: The bats keep teaching you to do awesome stuff!
CHAR.KAZHAN_l4: You can escape a fall two times in a run now!
CHAR.KAZHAN_l5: Flight is your second nature now. Grow wings more often and fly further!
CHAR.MEDUSA_bio: Four thousand years old but only speaks Ancient Greek.
CHAR.MEDUSA_l2: With that snaky complexion of yours, you'll be surprised what you can live through!
CHAR.MEDUSA_l3: You barely see living creatures anymore. Just statues. Statues everywhere... oh yessss.
CHAR.NATE_bio: A brilliant mechanic, Nate can wrench his way out of anything.
CHAR.NATE_l2: Look! Now you have a drone army!
CHAR.NATE_l3: Coordinate your drones to destroy every trap in sight!
CHAR.NATE_l4: Wreak trap-breaking havoc more often, make this dungeon a safer place!
CHAR.PB_bio: Don't panic. Everything is under control.
CHAR.PB_l2: Spend some of your charge to burn your way through the Dungeon!
CHAR.PB_l3: Your upgraded Panic Laser now consumes less battery juice per shot.
CHAR.PB_l4: You now have a stunning battery life of 40 seconds! I bet it's better than your smartphone's.
CHAR.PB_l5: Panic Laser barely consumes energy now. Let the laser show begin!
CHAR.RIBB_bio: It's not impossible to kill an undead, but it is hard.
CHAR.RIBB_l2: Ah, ah, ah, ah, staying alive!
CHAR.RIK_bio: His real name has 17 syllables, but you can call him simply Rik the Fire Golem.
CHAR.RIK_l2: Absorb fire and let it protect you. If the shield breaks, just absorb more fire. FIRE.
CHAR.RIK_l3: Your fire shields hold great power. Use them for defence or offence as the situation demands.
CHAR.RIK_l4: Fire has your back. Start every run with your shield already charged!
CHAR.VESNA_bio: Protector of life, only she can fight the Darkness.
CHAR.VESNA_l2: Kick the Darkness back when it's closing in!
CHAR.VESNA_l3: Kick the Darkness back twice as often. You're not afraid of it anymore.

FACTS.secret_achievement_2: Can't tell you what to do

GAMEOVER.not_bad: Not bad for the first run!

OPTIONS.coming_soon_desc: These options will be available in a future update
OPTIONS.control_scheme_desc: Choose the preferred device for on-screen prompts

SKILL.BATFRIEND_desc: Bats never attack you. You're like a brother to them.
SKILL.BLAZE_desc: Once your Flaming Shield is active, either keep it or use it as a missile of great power.
SKILL.BOO_desc: You can be really terrifying sometimes. Scare away all living things around you.
SKILL.BRIDGER_desc: You're really good at jumping. One-tile gaps are nothing for you, jump right over!
SKILL.COBWEB_desc: Spider webs can't stop you because you're constantly jumping.
SKILL.DARKWING_desc: You can turn into a bat and fly! It's not forever, so be careful where you land.
SKILL.DEXTERITY_desc: You have a chance to survive anything by dodging fast enough.
SKILL.ELECTRO_desc: You're not afraid of electricity... actually, you need it to operate, so watch your battery life and keep recharging!
SKILL.ESCABYSS_desc: If you fall, you immediately turn into a bat and fly to safety.
SKILL.FIREPROOF_desc: You are completely fireproof! You're also pretty tough: pistons can't crush you.
SKILL.FSHIELD_desc: Collect enchanted flames to activate a fire field that absorbs one hit. Restorable.
SKILL.GEM_desc:
You find 2×^ when your parrot friend Gem is around.

He's always in trouble. Rescue him and he'll follow you for a while.
SKILL.GREENPATH_desc: Plants flourish wherever you go. Vines cover fragile platforms and prevent them from crumbling.
SKILL.GUNSHOT_desc: Arrrgh, shoot stuff! Each shot costs you money, so try to stay cool.
SKILL.LIGHTRITUAL_desc: Push the chasing Darkness far back with pure force of Light.
SKILL.MECHFRIEND_desc: Technological marvel, this drone will fly two steps ahead and disarm traps for you.
SKILL.MECHSQUAD_desc: Your little army of drones is ridiculously effective at protecting you from traps.
SKILL.PANICLASER_desc: These upgraded eyeballs let you shoot lasers. Be careful though: shots use your battery charge!
SKILL.PETRI_desc: Your gaze turns creatures into fragile statues. Skeleton statues don't harm you.
SKILL.PORTALS_desc: You open up portals, but they are unstable and collapse in mere moments. Use them to skip ahead, but be careful!
SKILL.SHIELD_desc: Resist almost any damage! A shield won't save you from moving walls, electricity and fire.
SKILL.SPAREHEAD_desc: Nothing can kill you while you have spare heads... Just don't fall.
SKILL.TARGET_desc: Program your drones to break all traps around you in a coordinated attack!
SKILL.TELEKINESIS_desc: Get the treasure from all the chests around. This will also kill off mimics.
SKILL.THRUST_desc: Break or kill everything within three meters in front of you!
SKILL.TIMEBEND_desc: Slow motion! Slow the world down, stride past the quickest obstacles, catch up to those portals!
SKILL.TREASUREHUNT_desc: Your life is a huge treasure hunt. Collect keys and find treasure chests with extra loot, arrrgh!

PC.tap_step_desc: Tap the play area to move in swipe mode
PC.hold_run_desc: Keep moving while a direction is held
PC.smooth_light_desc: Filter light only; preserve sharp sprites
PC.soft_shadows_desc: Light blocked by walls and pillars
PC.wisp_glow_desc: Pulsing halo, floor light and stronger glow
PC.reset_warning: Reset your progress? All game data (coins, characters, records and achievements) will be erased. Settings will be kept.
PC.ui_size_desc: Adjusts menus and text, not the game camera
PC.dodge_hint: Follow the arrows. LB / RB: choose a pattern

CHAR_LYKOS.name: Lykos
CHAR_LYKOS.bio: A quiet woodcutter with a ravenous secret. Even his human jaws can crush skeletons.
CHAR_LYKOS.l2: Full moon: transform for 3 seconds. Resist contact traps; pits and webs remain dangerous. Recharge: 20 seconds.
CHAR_LYKOS.l3: Stay a wolf for 5 seconds. The dungeon slows around you. Recharge: 15 seconds.
CHAR_LYKOS.l4: Eat 5 skeletons to add 2 seconds to your next transformation.

SKILL_WOLFBITE.name: Powerful bite
SKILL_WOLFBITE.desc: Walk into skeletons to devour their bones, even in human form.

SKILL_FULLMOON.name: Full moon
SKILL_FULLMOON.desc: Become a wolf and resist contact traps. At level 3, the dungeon slows around you. Pits, webs, enemies, spells and darkness remain dangerous.

SKILL_REINFORCEMENT.name: Reinforcement
SKILL_REINFORCEMENT.desc: Every 5 skeletons eaten prepares +2 seconds for the next transformation. Gold dots show your progress.
